Measurement, 12 gate runs in one process (2026-11-18 PST). Each run calls rebar.llm.verify_completion(source="local") on its own spawn_context_daemon thread (the MCP *_start shape), against an isolated scratch store, reaching Bedrock with dummy credentials (provider 403):
- anyio 4.14.2 (current uv.lock): allocated blocks 636,038 -> 1,905,840; service-model OrderedDicts 18,444 -> 221,251. That is +115k blocks and +18,437 dicts per run, linear, with no levelling off. It is a leak, not a cache.
- anyio 4.16.0 (same venv otherwise): blocks 565,674 -> 566,832 over 12 runs (flat, under 100 per run of noise); OrderedDicts constant at 7.
- Single-variable confirmation in that venv: downgrading only anyio to 4.14.2 brings back +115k per run; 4.15.0 is flat.
The referrer chain is in the description. Fix: anyio>=4.15 floor plus re-lock (4.16.0). The new test fails on 4.14.2 (both the completed and raised drives) and passes on 4.16.0.
